tools.description: Accept browser dialog. Provide promptText for prompts.

tools.description: Clear collected console messages.
tools.name: clear_console_messages

tools.description: Clear the tracked downloads buffer.
tools.name: clear_downloads

tools.description: Clear snapshot cache. Usually not needed.
tools.name: clear_snapshot

tools.description: Click element by UID. Set dblClick for double-click.
tools.name: click_by_uid

tools.description: Close tab by index.
tools.name: close_page

tools.description: Dismiss browser dialog.
tools.name: dismiss_dialog

tools.description: Drag element to another (HTML5 drag events).
tools.name: drag_by_uid_to_uid

tools.description: Enable the JS debugger for the current page. Required before set_logpoint works. Requires Firefox 153+.
tools.name: enable_debugger

tools.description: Execute JS function in page. Prefer UID tools for interactions.

args.description: UIDs to pass as function arguments

preview.description: Number of characters of the saved result to return inline as a preview when saveTo is used. Omit for no preview.

saveTo.description: Save the result to a file as JSON instead of returning it inline. Pass a file path, an existing directory (generated file inside), or true (generated file under ~/.firefox-devtools-mcp/output/). Relative paths resolve against the current working directory.

tools.name: evaluate_script

tools.description: Fill text input/textarea by UID.
tools.name: fill_by_uid

tools.description: Fill multiple form fields at once.
tools.name: fill_form_by_uid

tools.description: Get information about the current Firefox instance configuration, including binary path, environment variables, and output file location.
tools.name: get_firefox_info

tools.description: Retrieve Firefox output (stdout/stderr including MOZ_LOG, warnings, crashes, stack traces). Returns recent output from the capture file. Use filters to focus on specific content.

grep.description: Filter log lines containing this string (case-insensitive)

lines.description: Number of recent log lines to return (default: 100, max: 10000)

since.description: Only show logs written in the last N seconds

tools.name: get_firefox_output

tools.description: Get the results collected by a logpoint since it was set.
tools.name: get_logpoint_results

tools.description: Get request details by ID. URL lookup as fallback.

preview.description: Number of characters of the saved output to return inline as a preview when saveTo is used. Omit for no preview.

saveTo.description: Save the request details with full untruncated headers to a file as JSON instead of returning them inline. Pass a file path, an existing directory (generated file inside), or true (generated file under ~/.firefox-devtools-mcp/output/). Relative paths resolve against the current working directory.

tools.name: get_network_request

tools.description: Get the source code of a JavaScript file loaded in the page. Requires enable_debugger to have been called.

scriptUrl.description: URL of the script to retrieve.

tools.name: get_script_source

tools.description: Hover over element by UID.
tools.name: hover_by_uid

tools.description: Install a Firefox extension using WebDriver BiDi webExtension.install command. Supports installing from archive (.xpi/.zip), base64-encoded data, or unpacked directory.

path.description: File path (for archivePath or path types)

permanent.description: Firefox-specific: Install permanently (requires signed extension). Default: false (temporary install)

type.description: Extension data type: "archivePath" for .xpi/.zip, "base64" for encoded data, "path" for unpacked directory

tools.name: install_extension

tools.description: List console messages. Supports filtering by level, time, text, source.

preview.description: Number of characters of the saved output to return inline as a preview when saveTo is used. Omit for no preview.

saveTo.description: Save matching messages to a file in full (untruncated) instead of returning them inline. Saves all matching messages by default; pass an explicit limit to cap how many are saved. Pass a file path, an existing directory (generated file inside), or true (generated file under ~/.firefox-devtools-mcp/output/). Relative paths resolve against the current working directory.

tools.name: list_console_messages

tools.description: List downloads tracked since startup, including status and saved file path.
tools.name: list_downloads

tools.description: List network requests. Returns IDs for get_network_request.

preview.description: Number of characters of the saved output to return inline as a preview when saveTo is used. Omit for no preview.

saveTo.description: Save matching requests to a file as JSON instead of returning them inline. Saves full untruncated headers by default; pass detail=summary or min for a lean form, or an explicit limit to cap how many are saved (default: all matching). Pass a file path, an existing directory (generated file inside), or true (generated file under ~/.firefox-devtools-mcp/output/). Relative paths resolve against the current working directory.

tools.name: list_network_requests

tools.description: List open tabs (index, title, URL). Selected tab is marked.
tools.name: list_pages

tools.description: List all JavaScript files currently loaded in the page. Requires enable_debugger to have been called.
tools.name: list_scripts

tools.description: Navigate history back/forward. UIDs become stale.
tools.name: navigate_history

tools.description: Navigate selected tab to URL.
tools.name: navigate_page

tools.description: Open new tab at URL. Returns tab index.
tools.name: new_page

tools.description: Check whether the Firefox profiler is currently recording.
tools.name: profiler_is_active

tools.description: Start the Firefox profiler. Provide either a preset name or explicit recording options (entries, interval, features, threads). Cannot combine both. Valid presets: web-developer, firefox-platform, graphics, media, ml, networking, power, debug.

activeContext.description: Id of the top-level navigable to mark as the active tab in the profile. Does not restrict profiling to that tab.

entries.description: Number of entries to keep in the sampling buffer. Required when no preset is given.

features.description: Profiler features to enable. Required when no preset is given.

interval.description: Sampling interval in milliseconds. Required when no preset is given.

preset.description: Profiler preset name. Cannot be combined with entries, interval, features, or threads.

threads.description: Thread names to profile. Required when no preset is given.

tools.name: profiler_start

tools.description: Stop the Firefox profiler and save the recorded profile to a file in the downloads directory. Returns the path to the saved file, or null when nothing was saved.

discard.description: If true, stop the profiler and discard the recording instead of saving it to disk. Defaults to false.

tools.name: profiler_stop

tools.description: Remove a previously set logpoint.
tools.name: remove_logpoint

tools.description: Resolve UID to CSS selector. Fails if stale.
tools.name: resolve_uid_to_selector

tools.description: Restart Firefox with different configuration. Allows changing binary path, environment variables, and other options. All current tabs will be closed.

env.description: New environment variables in KEY=VALUE format (optional, e.g., ["MOZ_LOG=HTMLMediaElement:5", "MOZ_LOG_FILE=/tmp/ff.log"])

firefoxPath.description: New Firefox binary path (optional, keeps current if not specified)

headless.description: Run in headless mode (optional, keeps current if not specified)

prefs.description: Firefox preferences to set at startup. Values are auto-typed: true/false become booleans, integers become numbers, everything else is a string. Requires MOZ_REMOTE_ALLOW_SYSTEM_ACCESS=1.

profilePath.description: Firefox profile path (optional, keeps current if not specified)

startUrl.description: URL to navigate to after restart (optional, uses about:blank if not specified)

tools.name: restart_firefox

tools.description: Start recording a screencast (video) of the current page viewport, saving the output to a file in the downloads directory. Returns a screencast id to pass to screencast_stop. Multiple recordings can run at once.

context.description: Id of the top-level browsing context to record. Defaults to the currently selected page.

frameRate.description: Target frame rate of the recording, in frames per second.

height.description: Height of the recorded video in pixels. Defaults to the viewport height.

mimeType.description: MIME type of the output file. Defaults to "video/webm".

width.description: Width of the recorded video in pixels. Defaults to the viewport width.

tools.name: screencast_start

tools.description: Stop an in-progress screencast recording started with screencast_start and finalize the video file. Returns the path to the saved file.

screencast.description: Id of the screencast to stop, as returned by screencast_start. Optional when exactly one recording is active.

tools.name: screencast_stop

tools.description: Capture element screenshot by UID as base64 PNG.

saveTo.description: Save the screenshot to a file instead of returning it as image data in the response. Pass a file path, an existing directory (generated file inside), or true (generated file under ~/.firefox-devtools-mcp/output/). Relative paths resolve against the current working directory.

tools.name: screenshot_by_uid

tools.description: Capture page screenshot as base64 PNG.

saveTo.description: Save the screenshot to a file instead of returning it as image data in the response. Pass a file path, an existing directory (generated file inside), or true (generated file under ~/.firefox-devtools-mcp/output/). Relative paths resolve against the current working directory.

tools.name: screenshot_page

tools.description: Select active tab by index, URL, or title. Index takes precedence.
tools.name: select_page

tools.description: Control how downloads are handled: allow (save silently to the default download directory), deny (cancel), or reset to default. Avoids the native save-file dialog. Requires a recent Firefox.

behavior.description: 'allowed' saves downloads automatically, 'denied' cancels them, 'default' resets to the browser default

tools.name: set_download_behavior

tools.description: Set a logpoint at a specific location. When execution reaches that line, the expression is evaluated and the result is stored without pausing. Use get_logpoint_results to retrieve collected values. Requires enable_debugger to have been called.

expression.description: JavaScript expression to evaluate each time the logpoint is hit.

tools.name: set_logpoint

tools.description: Set viewport dimensions in pixels.
tools.name: set_viewport_size

tools.description: Capture DOM snapshot with stable UIDs. Retake after navigation.

includeAll.description: Include all visible elements without relevance filtering. Useful for Vue/Livewire apps (default: false)

preview.description: Number of characters of the saved output to return inline as a preview when saveTo is used. Omit for no preview.

saveTo.description: Save the complete snapshot text to a file (ignores maxLines) instead of returning it inline. Pass a file path, an existing directory (generated file inside), or true (generated file under ~/.firefox-devtools-mcp/output/). Relative paths resolve against the current working directory.

selector.description: CSS selector to scope snapshot to specific element (e.g., "#app")

tools.name: take_snapshot

tools.description: Uninstall a Firefox extension using WebDriver BiDi webExtension.uninstall command. Requires the extension ID returned by install_extension or obtained from list_extensions.
tools.name: uninstall_extension

tools.description: Upload file to file input by UID.
tools.name: upload_file_by_uid
